_provenance: ZOU-277 eval-production parity allowlist. Records the INTENTIONAL asymmetries between the production scorecard surface (buildMetric calls in collector.ts) and the optimizer objective (multi-metric.ts defaultObjective targets) so the Eval-Production-Parity tripwire fires only on UNDECLARED divergence. Add an entry here when an asymmetry is deliberate; do not silence the tripwire any other way.

intentionalExclusions.name: Skill Effectiveness
intentionalExclusions.reason: Measured/displayed in the scorecard (weight 0.10) but not yet an optimization target — there is no prescribe playbook that moves it, so optimizing it would be a phantom target. Promote to an optimizer target when a playbook exists.

intentionalExclusions.name: RAG Health
intentionalExclusions.reason: LLM-judge faithfulness signal (weight 0.15); displayed but not an optimizer target. Non-deterministic and cost-bearing, so it informs the human rather than steering the autoloop.

intentionalExclusions.name: Chunk Health
intentionalExclusions.reason: Corpus chunk-cohesion signal (weight 0.08); displayed but not an optimizer target. Driven by the chunking pipeline, not by prescribe/evolve playbooks.

intentionalExclusions.name: Eval-Integrity
intentionalExclusions.reason: Weight-0 anti-Goodhart held-out tripwire — deliberately NEVER an optimizer target (adding it would let the loop game the examiner). See collector.ts measureEvalIntegrity + multi-metric.ts comment.

intentionalExclusions.name: Eval-Production Parity
intentionalExclusions.reason: This parity tripwire itself — weight-0, display-only. Making the metric-surface parity an optimization target would be circular (the loop could 'fix' parity by gaming the surface).

intentionalExclusions.name: Holdout Freshness
intentionalExclusions.reason: Weight-0 staleness tripwire for the anti-Goodhart held-out bank (ZOU-279) — display-only, deliberately NEVER an optimizer target (the examiner-refresh must stay outside the optimization loop, or the loop could influence its own hidden examiner). Mirrors Eval-Integrity.

acceptedWeightDivergences.name: Memory Recall
acceptedWeightDivergences.reason: Composite display weight (collector.ts) is tuned higher than the optimization weight (multi-metric.ts) by design; locked at this pair. A change to EITHER weight trips the tripwire for human review.

acceptedWeightDivergences.name: Episode Velocity
acceptedWeightDivergences.reason: Velocity is a softer signal in the composite than in the optimization objective; locked at this pair. A change to EITHER weight trips the tripwire for human review.
